Wang Lung (to the eldest son): "My sons, you are to do whatever I say and I am to do what I will. If I say you are not to do this or that, you are not to do it, and if I say that this land is to be sold, you are not to do it, even though I were to sell my flesh and my bones for gold. I would not sell it."

wang_lung.raw: I want them to understand the land is everything, and I will not let them take it, not even for a moment.
